scope: All 20 eligible Croatian county assembly inventory IDs; City of Zagreb and the national Parliament excluded because they have separate review scopes.
method: Individually inspected owned assembly/current notice routes and county-specific media/agenda/rights leads. Primary official sources only. Indexed content, page reads, linked providers, inaccessible targets and decoded playback remain distinct. All dispositions are partial source follow-ups, never full service validation.
interpretation_limits: No empty or unsuccessful search establishes that a stream does not exist.
A current county home or current session index does not validate every member, identifier, language, room, recording or rights use.
A general county video channel is not automatically a legislative video service; audio archives are labelled separately.
Invitation/summons text proves a scheduled event. Occurrence is asserted only where a separate official report/archive explicitly says held. Neither observation alone establishes broadcast start/end.
All displayed times are retained as published local-clock strings. No explicit timezone or broadcast end was verified; no invented duration is supplied.
No ICS/XMLTV/RSS broadcast programme feed was validated. HTML agenda text and linked documents can support future adapters after event mapping and reuse review.
Copyright footers, data-reuse frameworks, personal-copying clauses and actual video-provider terms have different scopes. No national/parent licence is inherited.
Browser plugin was unavailable; one temporary Playwright Chromium attempt was inconclusive and stopped. No playback claim is based on it.
No outreach, sign-in, access-control bypass, raw HTML archiving or copied credential retention.
